events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the day Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas in 1996, leading to his death six days later.

angles.name: Legacy of an icon
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact Tupac Shakur had on music and culture. His influence continues to resonate decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the passing of rock legend Jimi Hendrix in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar god remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work remains as groundbreaking today as it ever was.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: That legendary zebra crossing. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that unforgettable cover, dropped on this day in '69. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting for The Pretenders have given us so many anthems.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that iconic swagger to the stage.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: A timeless message of peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The device that changed music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy royalty's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is simply timeless.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled 'White Album' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A masterpiece in white
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled stage presence and vocal power live on forever.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. This album marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. A true classic!

events.title: John Lennon Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a peace advocate
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
